toegepas.rede_vinder: The lesson uses the protected pair 'tekens en simptome' everywhere else; this one reversed order is the only exception and reads as a different phrase.
toegepas.fout: The original uses 'simptome en tekens', which the BESKERM list names as a NIE form of the protected pair 'tekens en simptome'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Restores the protected word order used everywhere else in the lesson without changing what the sentence says.

toegepas.voor: droë hoes wat twee weke aanhou
toegepas.na: droë hoes wat twee weke lank aanhou
toegepas.rede_vinder: A duration with 'aanhou' is idiomatically 'twee weke lank aanhou', as the glossary's 'weke lank aanhou' already has it.
toegepas.fout: A duration with 'aanhou' reads more naturally with 'lank', as the glossary's 'weke lank aanhou' has it.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The idiomatic duration form, with the same two weeks and no change to the claim.

toegepas.blok: Ander tekens en simptome van TB
toegepas.na: Koors: die mens se liggaam is warmer
toegepas.rede_vinder: The list opens with 'sy' and 'hy' but has no antecedent under its own heading; naming the person once in the first item gives the later pronouns something to refer to.
toegepas.fout: The list block opens with 'sy' and 'hy' but has no person they refer to under its own heading.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Naming the person once gives the later pronouns something to refer to; it adds no fact and stays within the list allowance.

laat_vaar.voor: glo jy kry TB uit 'n beker, 'n bord of kos wat gedeel word
laat_vaar.na: glo jy kry TB as jy 'n beker, 'n bord of kos met iemand deel
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'TB uit 'n beker kry' with a trailing passive is wooden; an active 'as jy ... deel' is more natural and keeps the meaning.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The meaning moves: the original refutes a myth about shared objects, while 'met iemand deel' makes it about sharing with a person, and being near someone with TB can pass it on through the air, so the refutation would become misleading.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat die kliniek met masels doen
laat_vaar.voor: masels gaan ook kliniek toe. Maar geen medisyne
laat_vaar.na: masels gaan ook kliniek toe, maar geen medisyne
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The contrast reads more smoothly as one sentence; the AWS comma before 'maar' applies because both halves have their own subject and verb.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: A lateral move: a short sentence starting with 'Maar' already reads well for Grade 5 and gives the contrast emphasis, and joining them only makes the sentence longer.

vlae.teks: Iemand met 'n droë hoes wat twee weke aanhou, gaan ook kliniek toe.
vlae.rede: Two sentences earlier the rule is 'twee weke of langer' with 'moet'; this sentence says only 'twee weke' and 'gaan', so the two may read as different rules. Aligning them would change content, so it is flagged, not changed.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: TB kan gesond gemaak word / Die kliniek kan TB gesond maak
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: In Afrikaans 'gesond maak' is usually said of a person, not a disease ('n siekte word genees); the phrasing is understandable but slightly unidiomatic. Not changed, because it is protected and the forbidden list rules out the 'genees' forms.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Ander tekens en simptome van TB
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Probeer' here needs an object ('dit') to read naturally.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Sonder dat hy probeer' is already natural Afrikaans; adding 'dit' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Die kliniek kan TB gesond maak
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: help hom om by te hou
laat_vaar_vorige.na: help hom om vol te hou
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Byhou' means keeping pace with something; 'volhou' is the idiom for persevering with a treatment.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Byhou' (keeping up with the doses) and 'volhou' (persevering) say different things about what the clinic does, and the original is acceptable Afrikaans.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Waar masels vandaan kom en hoe dit lyk
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: en trek af oor die lyf
laat_vaar_vorige.na: en versprei dan afwaarts oor die lyf
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Trek af' can be read as 'pull off'; 'versprei afwaarts' keeps the downward spread unambiguous.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Trek af oor die lyf' is clear in context, and 'versprei dan afwaarts' is longer and stiffer for a Grade 5 reader without being clearly better.
